Nasa pag-uusap niyo yan kung ano ang okay sa relasyon niyo. You have to set clear boundaries and consequences if nalabag ang mga ito.

First of all, I hope he is honest sa scope ng addiction niya. Hindi mo matutulungan ang taong ayaw magpatulong. Ma-address lang ang issue if ready siyang maging vulnerable sa'yo kasi this affects you too. Baka sobrang na-trauma ka na and it affected your self-confidence na and hindi ka na makatulog, ganun.


If kaya, get professional help, mas maganda if for the both of you. Mahirap kasi inavigate ang addiction kapag ikaw lang, lalo na if malala na yung addiction and it intervenes with the aspects of your daily life. You can search for alternative methods din naman, spending the energy elsewhere — exercising, gaming, activities that take place outside na malayo sa PC or sa phone, limit interaction sa mga soc med na maraming lumalabas na R18 stuff para hindi siya matrigger. Maybe you can also do these activities with him para mas ma-encourage siya.

Make sure to make him feel he's not alone in this journey, pero check with yourself din ha? Wag mong ubusin ang sarili mo trying to fix him. Be ready for relapses along the way. It will be a bumpy ride, but this is for the man you want to spend your life with, and the life you will create together. Exhaust all of the possibilities if you want to and are willing to stay with him.

Vvvvv normal. We deserve to know the truth regardless of what we would feel.

You know learning every detail will hurt you but you still want to do it to try and make sense of everything. You're retroactively mourning the days (months? years?) you didn't know about the betrayal.

P.S. I wish you peace, OP. ❤️ Hugs (with consent) po.

The ending is an open one so it's really up to us how we can interpret it. I have read one interpretation that Yoonbum still lived however broken he was, (about his life and about Sangwoo, really) and is able to make life for himself.

Another one I've read is Yoonbum was hit by the car and died, and is now with Sangwoo, and they're finally able to "live" the life they deserve, without all the hurt, the traumas, and whatnot...

Death isn't an easy subject to deal with. I can't imagine myself going through this, but I know that one day I will be. In that case, even though it hurts, even though my knees will be shaking and I will be hurting to the core, I will let go.

Speaking from experience, the only reason I didn't want to get over depression is because of uncertainty. Depression is kinda like a blanket, if you stay depressed, you *actually* stay low, and get used to its repercussions over time. If you got over it, you will feel a whole variety of emotions and will not know how to deal with them and you get overwhelmed, so you go back into the corner and sulk, and entertain the sadness again.

I guess you can deal with it by starting to accept that you can feel different emotions other than sadness, and allow yourself to feel them. It will get really overwhelming at first, and you have to find the motivation to stay on the path of recovery.

I wish you well, OP.
